commands_run: cd /workspace && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 16.19.1 && npx gulp
cd /workspace && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && npm run react
cd /workspace/e2e-comparison && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
notes: Angular dev server uses gulp express on port 9001 per gulpfile.js (README documents 9001).
React Vite dev server on 5173 with API proxy to localhost:9000 per web-react/vite.config.ts.
Playwright globalSetup fetches admin auth from POST /api/v1/auth into e2e-comparison/.auth-cache.json (gitignored) for seeding Angular localStorage.
AUDIT_PROJECT_SLUG defaults to project-1 (sample_data); override if seed differs.
Migration and audit branches pointed to the same commit in this workspace clone (PR branch tip).
